meta.note: INP files unavailable in project; model HGL COMPUTED by piecewise hydraulic-gradient interpolation between real model fixed-head control nodes (reservoir heads, tank levels, pump lifts) — NOT a wntr steady-state EPANET solve. Every elevation traces to a real model node.
meta.hglMethod: piecewise-gradient-interpolation, feasibility-clamped to +5 m residual over high points
meta.decimationMethod: elevation extrema (prominence ≥ 1.5 m) + LTTB shape fill + Douglas-Peucker top-up (ε=1.8 m)
